speaker: Penny
text: What do you mean transgressions I've committed? Like, what? Oh, yeah, yeah, I see you. You're making a little check sign in the air. I gotta just hold your horses. What does Leonard complain about?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Were you under the impression that Leonard has no complaints about you? You're driving? The plethora of stuffed animals on your bed that stare at him during your amorous activities? Your constant tardiness? Your singing?

speaker: Penny
text: My singing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That's actually from my list, but Leonard'd be a fool if he didn't agree with it.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, if Leonard has so many problems with me, why hasn't he just said so?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Because according to him, you're oversensitive and have a temper.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, really? Well, then do me a favor and tell Leonard that he can drop dead.

speaker: Sheldon
text: And she wonders why she's constantly under-tipped. Oh, good, you're home. I need you to do me a favor. Go apologize to Penny. Right now would be good. Although a few minutes ago would have been better.

speaker: Leonard
text: Hey. What?

speaker: Penny
text: Leonard!

speaker: Penny
text: I hear you don't like my stuffed animals, my driving, or my punctuality.

speaker: Leonard
text: What? Who would tell you something like that? Why would you tell her something like that?

speaker: Penny
text: It doesn't matter why he told me. It's true, isn't it?

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, yeah, it's true, but I can live with that stuff. What I can't live with is you casually informing me that some guy's gonna be staying in your apartment without even asking me first.

speaker: Penny
text: That isn't even your problem. The problem is you don't trust me.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, come on, Sheldon. Have you ever once heard me say that I don't trust Penny?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sheldon, where did he go?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, your yelling must have freaked him out again.

speaker: Leonard
text: Where are you going? You can just walk away in the middle of an argument?

speaker: Penny
text: No, I'm gonna go find your damn roommate before he hurts himself trying to cross the street or something.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why didn't you say so?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, now I need your permission for that, too?

speaker: Leonard
text: I can't read your mind, Penny.

speaker: Penny
text: Really, why not? You're so smart and I'm so dumb.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Raj. Raj. Raj.

speaker: Raj
text: Stop knocking, it's open. Please tell my parents that our dark matter research is at a critical juncture and I can't come home for my cousin Sanjay's wedding. I didn't ask you to set me up with Lakshmi.

speaker: Mummy
text: Sheldon, ask Hassan what we're supposed to say to Mr. and Mrs. Chaudhry whose daughter Lakshmi is flying in from London for the sole purpose of meeting him. You should be thanking us.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes, Lakshmi just got her stomach stapled. You have an opportunity to get in good with her before she loses weight and her self-esteem goes up.

speaker: Raj
text: I don't care. And why don't you think I can find a woman for myself?

speaker: Mummy
text: Because you're 27 and the closest thing we have to a daughter-in-law is that Jewish boy Howard.

speaker: Raj
text: Oh, that is completely below the belt. Sheldon, tell my parents that Howard and I are just friends. Sheldon? Howard and I are just friends.
